compiled_state.description:
## testing_mode: GREEN

Update the Output Schema section in the security red team delta to replace the stale schema description with a current, accurate allowlist.

## Files to Modify
- plugins/dso/docs/workflows/prompts/reviewer-delta-security-red-team.md

## Acceptance Criteria

Replace the ENTIRE paragraph in ## Output Schema (starting with "Your output MUST conform...") with:

"Your output MUST conform to the standard reviewer-findings.json schema (2 required top-level keys: findings, summary). Each finding in the findings array must use ONLY fields from this allowlist: severity, category, description, file, cited_lines. Prefix each finding description with the security criterion name in brackets (e.g., '[TOCTOU] Race condition between...'). Do NOT add non-allowlisted fields (rationale, confidence, taxonomy_category) — they degrade output quality and are not read by the review pipeline. Use the summary field to note overall security posture and confidence level."

Key changes:
1. "3 top-level keys: scores, findings, summary" → "2 required top-level keys: findings, summary" (scores is deprecated)
2. "Do NOT add extra fields" → enumerated allowlist: severity, category, description, file, cited_lines
3. Remove false claim "the validator rejects non-standard fields" — the validator does NOT currently reject extra finding fields; the allowlist is a behavioral instruction
4. PRESERVE the description-prefix instruction ("[TOCTOU] ...") — this is security-specific guidance that lives only in this delta file

No other sections to modify.
